summary: Exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.1 runtime and browser acceptance completed against the PR #53 descendant without product changes. Provider, semantic-cache, evidence-cache, no-store refocus, fallback truthfulness, prompt-in-image boundary, PR #52 routes, settings UI, and the compiled browser send-hook count/privacy seams were exercised. The rc.1 host opened normally but did not expose a draft-image/file-input composer in this isolated no-model session, so main-model-only routing, normal rendered user bubbles, and host call/debug cards remain PARTIAL rather than being claimed as PASS.
